prompt:
Build the browser application described below.

Requirement:
Deleting a Nextcloud file moves it to the trash rather than erasing it immediately, so it can be restored later.

Implementation interface:
Implement one self-contained HTML page using vanilla JavaScript with no external resources. Consume window.initialState.files with id and name. Provide accessible All files and Deleted files view buttons, file rows with data-file-id, and an accessible Delete button for each active file. The two views must be operable without page reload. Return only raw HTML.
